Seattle Municipal Code (SMC), Title 22, Subtitle VIII, Chapters 22.800–22.808 (Stormwater Code).
City of Seattle Stormwater Manual (SDCI Director's Rule 10-2021 / SPU Director's Rule DWW-200).
Official Reference: https://library.municode.com/wa/seattle/codes/municipal_code?nodeId=TIT22BUCOCO_SUBTITLE_VIIISTCO
original_excerpt:
From Seattle Municipal Code § 22.800.010:
"This subtitle, comprised of Chapters 22.800 through 22.808, shall be known as the 'Stormwater Code' and may be cited as such."   

From Seattle Municipal Code § 22.800.020 & City of Seattle Stormwater Manual (Directors' Rule DWW-200 / SDCI 10-2021):
Chapter 22.800 establishes the title, purpose, scope, and authority governing all grading, drainage, and land-disturbing activities in Seattle, while specific drainage calculation methodologies and flow control modeling standards (such as continuous runoff modeling and the Single Event Hydrograph Method) are codified across Chapters 22.800–22.808 and elaborated under the incorporated Stormwater Manual (Appendix F).
fidelity: Title sentence corroborated in City draft carrying unchanged title language. Official 2021 Appendix F supports hydrologic methods, but no historical enacted-code copy was secured in this turn. Do not call an absent local U.S. Reports source a false quotation.
pinpoint: 22.800.010 title; scope belongs to 22.800.030, not merely .020 purpose; Appendix F F-1/F-2 and single-event modeling guidance.
scope_note: Remove or qualify 'all' grading/drainage activities; methods depend on facility/performance standard. Single-event methods are for conveyance, not an interchangeable substitute for continuous flow-control modeling. Version applicability remains unresolved.
previous_record_verification: No previous in-scope closure relied on.
